subject: Midsignal: Redistributing roles & Q4 check-in notes
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, BrightLayer HR <hr@brightlayer.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: role redistribution for Q4 check-ins

Hi Maya and Laura,

Following our leadership sync yesterday, I finished the first-pass redistribution matrix for the team we discussed (attached). Key points: 

- Two ICs on Team Orion will move from Maya -> Marcus for the next two quarters to balance with expected hiring timelines.
- We propose consolidating one product lead role across Project Delta and Project Echo; that will require a short overlap handoff.
- I flagged three people as high-touch for Q4 check-ins; these will have manager-only 1:1s plus a paired calibration meeting.

Can you review the matrix and the short manager guidance doc? I need a decision on the Orion moves by EOD Tuesday to coordinate comp/HR notices. If you prefer, we can run a 30-min sync Monday morning to walk through.

Attachments: Q4_redistribution_matrix.xlsx, manager_guidance_midsignal.docx

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior People Partner, People Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: role redistribution for Q4 check-ins

Monica — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear matrix. A few quick questions after a skim: 

1) For the two ICs moving to Marcus: what is the proposed reporting date? That will affect a couple of planned milestones this month.
2) For the product lead consolidation: do we expect the role to be backfilled in Q1 or remain consolidated through mid-2028?
3) Are there any comp/bonus implications I should flag to my directs now (or hold until HR outreach)?

I can do a 30-min call Monday 9:00–9:30 PT to walk through, or if you want to push a decision to Tuesday EOD I can make time then.

Also looping Marcus because capacity questions land on him.

—Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Director, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: role redistribution for Q4 check-ins

Thanks for the notes. Quick operational constraints from my side: 

- I can absorb the two ICs starting Nov 15, but need a 2-week overlap with Maya for context on legacy telemetry work.
- My team has a mid-Nov sprint freeze (Nov 22–26); any onboarding that week will be noisy.
- If comp/bonus timing is the question, please coordinate with BrightLayer HR — we need clear language to avoid expectations about bonus prorating.

If Monday morning is being used, I recommend we keep the agenda tight: 1) confirm move-in dates, 2) confirm handoff owner for each deliverable, 3) confirm communication plan to ICs. I can make time Mon 9:00–9:30.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Compute Platform

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLayer HR <hr@brightlayer.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: role redistribution for Q4 check-ins

Adding a few redlines from my side after reviewing the guidance doc: 

- Please include a mandatory 1:1 calibration check after two weeks and again at six weeks for any redistributed ICs. Add those to the handoff spreadsheet so managers get calendar invites automatically.
- For the product lead consolidation, we should treat it as an FY28 interim structure (i.e., backfill candidate search to start Jan 2028). That reduces ambiguity for PM/ENG pairing during the holidays.
- HR: please confirm that the standard relocation/compensation language will not apply — these moves are internal and temporary.

I attached a one-page handoff template to standardize notes (handoff-one-pager.pdf). I'm ok with Nov 15 start for the two ICs provided we get the overlap.

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering — Core Systems
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLayer HR <hr@brightlayer.com>, AcmeCorp People Ops <peopleops@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 16:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: role redistribution for Q4 check-ins

Thanks all — good sync. Summary & actions: 

- Decision: two ICs will move to Marcus on Nov 15 with a 2-week overlap (Nov 15–26).
- Product lead consolidation treated as interim through FY28; recruitment for a permanent backfill starts Jan 10, 2028.
- Laura to add the two-week and six-week calibration checkpoints into the handoff spreadsheet (Laura: can you add calendar invites by Monday?).
- Monica/HR: please prepare the internal communication draft and confirm no comp changes; BrightLayer HR to reply with final language by Tues Nov 9.

I uploaded an updated matrix with the confirmed dates here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB-cExampleDriveLink

I'll run a brief follow-up with managers after HR confirmation. If anything changes, flag in this thread so we keep auditability for the org file.

—Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Director, Product Engineering
